clauses.quote: Upon returning from a leave of absence without pay, the teacher will resume contract status as a contract teacher.
All contract teachers will be eligible for Military Leave, Jury Duty Leave, and Public Office Leave as specified in Board Policy.
clauses.notes: References Board Policy but grants eligibility.

clauses.quote: The Association will be allowed up to 120 days of Association Leave for teachers to be released from normal duties at the request of the Association for the purposes of performing those duties associated with representation of the bargaining unit and promoting educational benefits for students, teachers, administrators, Granite Education Association, and the Granite School District Board of Education.
Released time for the following, when scheduled during working hours, shall be provided without loss of pay
clauses.subject_text: Released time for the following, when scheduled during working hours
clauses.notes: Captures operative duty before the colon and list.

clauses.quote: Up to 60 of the 120 days of Association Leave may be recognized by the District as having direct benefit to the students and instructional programs of Granite School District.
clauses.subject_text: Up to 60 of the 120 days of Association Leave
clauses.notes: Management discretion to classify leave days for substitute payment purposes.

clauses.quote: Such leave days shall be provided without loss of pay and without Association payment for substitutes.
The Association will pay the substitute costs for all other Association Leave days
the District will allow the employee to be released without loss of pay.

Requests for Association Leave, and a summary statement relative to the outcome of the leave (benefit to Granite School District and/or the Association), must be submitted by the executive director of the Association in writing, on District approved forms, to the Superintendent or designee.
clauses.subject_text: Requests for Association Leave, and a summary statement relative to the outcome of the leave (benefit to Granite School District and/or the Association)
clauses.notes: Administrative filing requirement on the union.

clauses.quote: The executive director of the Association will determine whether the leave requires the payment of substitute costs.
clauses.subject_text: The executive director of the Association
clauses.notes: Discretionary authority granted to union leadership.

clauses.quote: An evaluation of all Association Leave days relative to the purpose and outcome of such leaves will be conducted by the Association and District administration prior to July 15 of each year.
clauses.subject_text: An evaluation of all Association Leave days relative to the purpose and outcome of such leaves
clauses.notes: Joint administrative task for both parties.
